column3: その頃、魔軍、バボラの部下達

column4: Please send out one Monster General as the captain of Babolat's guards; personality is up to you.

column4: Operational orders from Kayblis, but Babolat is stupid and can't understand them easily.

column3: ケッセルリンク様の部隊には下手に出ているらしいぜとかも
column4: Apparently, Babolat acts submissively toward Kesselring-sama's troops as well.

column3: 先日、人間の特攻部隊がバボラ様の足に取り付いて少し怪我をさせた。
column4: The other day, a human suicide squad attached to Babolat-sama's foot and caused a slight injury.

column4: Babolat-sama has an invincible barrier, so injury is impossible, maybe it was a mistake.

column3: なんにしろ人間どもにそこまで近づかれたのは我々のミス、以後、警戒を怠らないようにとか
column4: Anyway, it was our mistake to let humans get that close; don't neglect vigilance in the future.

column3: この魔物将軍、バボラが上司だし、バカだし、困っているが
column4: This Monster General is troubled because Babolat is his boss and is stupid.

column3: それでも上司として守ろうとしている
column4: Still, he tries to protect him as his superior.

column3: バボラが起きる、うーーー、飯。飯まだか
column4: Babolat wakes up, 'Uhhh, food... is it ready yet?'

column3: さっき食べましたよー
えーっと、何すればいいんだっけ？
column4: Um, what am I supposed to do again?

column4: Yes, please advance westward, that's right. There's a human fortress there, so please crush it.
